title: Agents: inviting an email that already belongs to an active user creates a second, pending user for the same email
label: BUG · Medium
env: TAVI: staging-desk.taviportal.com, NDC-Staging (Wonder Travel), owner · Zoho Desk: techsolutionsegypt (Enterprise trial), admin · Edge

panels.caption: TAVI · Setup › Agents › All Agents, search mmohamed@anyware (already an active CRM Admin user)
Zoho · Agents › New Agent · email of the existing agent typed (not saved)
TAVI · GET /iam/users after the invite: two rows for one email

rows: Inviting an email that already belongs to an active user
The New Agent form takes the existing agent's email with no message while typing. Zoho checks only on Save, which was not pressed, so what Zoho does next was not checked.
Accepted (200) with no warning. The Agents list shows a new row for mmohamed@anyware.software: Pending, Desk Agent, Invited.
Not checked (would need Save). Zoho's Agents list shows one row per agent.
Two users for the same email: row 1 Invited / Desk Agent (empty user id 00000000…), row 2 active / CRM Admin. The existing user is not given Desk access; a separate invitation is created instead.
